findings.motion: adoption of SJR 37 (Record 2196), constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen
findings.note: Ben Bumgarner is listed among the Yeas on adoption of SJR 37 in the House Journal (Record 2196: 102 Yeas, 14 Nays, 22 Present not voting). The measure proposes a constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen. The House Journal lists the member as 'Bumgarner'.

Texas Legislature Online lists Bumgarner among the coauthors of HB 5337 (2025), 'Relating to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote; creating criminal offenses.' The page gives no authorization date.
